manifest.name: card
manifest.title: Card
manifest.description: A bounded surface that groups one subject, with a header (title, description, action), content and a footer; padding follows density.
manifest.usage: Use Card for one subject among several on a page: a connection on the start screen, a saved query, a metric with its Stat. Compose Card > CardHeader (CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction), CardContent, CardFooter; every part is optional. variant="raised" lifts it off bg.canvas, "inset" makes a quiet group inside another surface. Do not nest cards, and do not use one as a page section with a single child: a heading and Separator are lighter. For a list of many records use Table.

props.name: variant
props.description: outline on the page surface, raised with elevation, inset for a quiet group.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render an <article> or <section> instead of the <div>.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Title and action on one line, the description below; data-slot="card-header".

slots.name: title
slots.description: The heading in text.heading-4; wraps long names; data-slot="card-title".

slots.name: description
slots.description: Secondary text in text.caption, color.fg.muted; data-slot="card-description".

slots.name: action
slots.description: Controls at the header's end; data-slot="card-action".

slots.name: footer
slots.description: A wrapping row of actions; data-slot="card-footer".

parts.name: CardHeader
parts.description: The top of the card: title and action on the first line, description below.

parts.name: CardTitle
parts.description: The heading, an <h3> by default; render another level with render.

parts.name: CardDescription
parts.description: One or two lines under the title.

parts.name: CardAction
parts.description: Buttons or a menu trigger at the header's end.

parts.name: CardFooter
parts.description: Actions or facts at the bottom, in a row that wraps.

accessibility: A plain grouping element; render an <article> or <section> when the card is a self-contained item or a labelled region.
CardTitle is a heading (<h3>), so screen-reader users can jump between cards; pick the level that fits the page with render.
Not focusable itself; the controls inside are reached in reading order.
Long titles and descriptions wrap (wrap-break-word), so nothing is cut off at any width or density.
